glyph_origin: Ideogrammic compound (會意): 屮 (“bud”) + 一 (“ground”) – sprouting from the ground. A conservative version is 𤯓, which is unrelated to 㞷 (匩 > 匡) and 𡴀 > 丰.
senses: [shēng] to live; to subsist; to exist
[shēng] to grow; to develop; to bud
(music) Cantonese opera gongche notation for the note high do (1̇).
[sāng] (Hong Kong, honorific, suffix) -san, when referring to a Japanese person
